_about: Inputs for the dashboard's Bills tab that the Nebius billing export doesn't carry. scripts/finops-export.sh merges this with the export. No IDs or card details here.

balance.note: Card top-up on 21 Oct; October consumption is charged at month end.

run_window.note: Demo endpoint must be up from submission until judging ends.

rates.note: From the 21 Oct export: cpu-d3 2 cores x $0.015 + 8 GiB RAM x $0.0045 per hour; 20 GiB network SSD at about $0.000097 per GiB-hour. No charges while stopped.

pending_readings.what: Token spend (Nemotron + Qwen embeddings) is billed outside the AI Cloud export. Read it from the Token Factory console and add it to manual_costs.
